title: Fancy Yellow pear diamond drop earrings
subtitle: Fancy Yellow is one of the most expressive diamond colors at weight — and at nearly 15 carats across two matched stones, the color becomes something different from what it is at smaller scale. The pear shape was chosen for its directionality: the pointed tip catches light differently than the shoulder, so the yellow moves as the stones move. One matched pair, each stone identical in cut and color distribution, each presenting the same warmth at the same moment.
